name: Diesel particulate filter (DPF) regeneration
description: Makes the engine burn off the soot in the DPF while the car is stationary. Diesel only. The exhaust gets very hot - outdoors, away from anything that can burn, and never under the car while it runs.
source: Waiting for the commands to be found on a real car
preconditions: Engine warm, at least a quarter tank of fuel
Outdoors, bonnet up, nothing near the exhaust
